title: [P2] Deliver the existing W2 native-eager candidate and current-build qualification manifest

labels.name: P2
labels.description: Provenance/observability, or a claim stated beyond its evidence

body:
Continue Tessera #1380 through the existing #689/PrismaQuant #2545 owners. Use W1 to identify required eager scopes and provide an immutable supported candidate plus authoritative manifest schema and replay/verification instructions. Bind exact source, native-extension build/compiler identity, configured image digest, runtime/device, artifact and cell/rung/shape/activation/residency/regime/TP scope to commands, native launch attribution, numerical and boundary outcomes, and raw-log digests. Establish whether the configured Tessera GPU arm is the required image X; release-pinned availability alone does not establish exact-X qualification. Keep deployment values in existing configuration.

The current v67 contract has no attested BF16 or E2M1 rungs. BF16 receipts were withdrawn after arithmetic changed, and historical T4 receipts do not qualify the current paired WINDOW/LUT14 owner. Supply current support and qualification only where W1 requires those scopes; neither blindly restore old menus nor relabel historical receipts. Preserve existing dispatch restrictions, unsupported-input behavior and current consumer compatibility. Reuse the existing 880/912 admission tests rather than rerunning a duplicate census. Deliver candidate custody independently of W10 publication; publish new claims only after the downstream evidence join. Use plain configured checks, not nested PrismaBuild submission, private environments or package installation.
